subject: Request: short POC stabilization window + sandbox credits for OptiScale
messages:
From: Aaron Patel <aaron@optiscale.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@optiscale.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: OptiScale POC - request for short bridge and sandbox credits

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the platform demo last week — the team is excited about the latency profile. Unfortunately we've hit a blocker during validation: the third-party pricing connector we depend on (PriceStream v2) is returning truncated identifiers during batching, which causes our ingest pipeline to fail validation on ~18% of test payloads.

Our engineers estimate a 7–10 business day correction for the connector (it's with a separate vendor), and that pushes our internal demo and procurement timeline beyond the POC window. Given the delay, we need two things to avoid losing momentum: a short 10-business-day POC extension and a top-up of sandbox credits so our team can continue realistic volume testing after the patch is in place.

Can Redwood approve a limited extension + credits? We are proposing: 10 additional business days and 50k sandbox-token credit.

Attached: optiscale_integration-log.txt (relevant error excerpts) and optiscale_system-design.pdf (high-level diagram).

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk the logs.

Best,
Aaron
Aaron Patel
Head of Platform & Integrations, OptiScale
aaron@optiscale.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Patel <aaron@optiscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OptiScale POC - request for short bridge and sandbox credits

Aaron — thanks for the clear summary and for the logs. Sorry to hear about the connector issue; that kind of external dependency is always frustrating during a POC.

Looping in Ben (sales) and Marissa (CS) to confirm commercial flexibility, and Karthik from engineering to scope whether our side can help triage before their vendor patch is delivered.

Ben/Marissa/Karthik — quick ask: can we (a) grant a short POC extension, and (b) top up sandbox credits while OptiScale completes the vendor fix? Aaron asked for 50k tokens; if we can offer something smaller with an engineering assist it may keep momentum without a big credit concession.

Aaron — I'll follow up with a definitive reply within 48 business hours. Can you share a preferred time for a 30–45 minute troubleshooting session this week if Karthik thinks it's useful?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OptiScale POC - request for short bridge and sandbox credits

Neha — I support offering a pragmatic bridge. Context on the account: OptiScale is a high-propensity mid-market opportunity (forecast commit next quarter) and they showed clear usage intent in the demo (12k tokens/day simulated). If we do nothing we risk losing momentum and the close window.

Proposal:
- Approve 10 business days additional POC window (official amendment).
- Sandbox credit top-up: 40,000 tokens (we can split into two deliveries if needed).
- Include 1 × 60-minute remote debug session with one of our engineers (Karthik) to triage their logs.
- Require a short amendment via DocuSign confirming extension and that credits are one-time, non-recurring.

If engineering suggests we need to push more credit we can revisit, but for speed I'd prefer a smaller credit + engineer assist.

Neha — I can prepare the DocuSign amendment if you want. Also adding HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/9823.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Oct 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OptiScale POC - request for short bridge and sandbox credits

Quick technical read: I went through the integration log Aaron sent. The truncated identifiers look like a batching key mismatch when going through their transform layer into PriceStream v2—this is consistent with a schema drift on the vendor side.

Estimate: if we only advise and run a paired-debug session, we can identify a mitigation (workaround/filter) within 1–2 business days; a full vendor patch is outside OptiScale's control and will take the 5–8 business days they estimated. We can push an interim filter to their ingest to reduce failure rate and restore realistic validation load.

I'm happy to take the 60-minute remote session Ben proposed. Recommend we offer the 40k tokens + two-week extension (10 business days), and include the remote session the week after next to walk the workaround and validate. If Aaron still needs more credits after we apply the workaround, we can top up an additional tranche.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Inference Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Patel <aaron@optiscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@optiscale.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Oct 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OptiScale POC - request for short bridge and sandbox credits

Aaron — good news: we can support your stabilization window. Summary of what Redwood will provide: 

- POC extension: 10 business days (effective immediately; new end date: 2028-10-25).
- Sandbox credit top-up: 40,000 tokens applied to your sandbox environment (one-time, non-recurring).
- Engineering assist: 1 × 60-minute remote debug session with Karthik Iyer scheduled for 
  Thu, 11 Oct 2028 at 10:00 AM PT (please confirm availability).

Action items for OptiScale:
1) Please confirm that the requested debug slot works for your engineering lead.
2) Sign the short amendment that Ben will send via DocuSign (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/amendment-9823). This documents the extension and one-time credit grant.

Notes: We reviewed the ask and decided on 40k tokens rather than 50k given the planned engineering assist; if the workaround does not materially reduce failures we can consider an incremental tranche after the session (requires follow-up approval). The credits are one-off and intended to let you finish validation once the vendor patch arrives.

Attachments: I retained your logs for the meeting (optiscale_integration-log.txt).

Happy to help move the call to an earlier slot if needed.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182
